aboutGame.title: What is Shogun's Reign?
paragraphs: Shogun's Reign is an Edo-period Japan roleplay and progression game on Roblox. You start as a common laborer, earn Ryō through jobs and trade, build reputation, and climb the social hierarchy toward the ultimate title of Shogun.

Along the way you can master professions such as Farmer, Merchant, Artisan, and Attendant, craft charms and gear, improve your home, explore towns and shrines, and redeem codes for free rewards. Our wiki covers every system with step-by-step guides, data tables, and practical tips.

highlights.detail: Lock in one dependable income source before you spend on anything else.
Secure a single defensible border so you only ever fight on one front.

faq.title: Shogun's Reign FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common Shogun's Reign questions.

items.question: What is Shogun's Reign?
items.answer: Shogun's Reign is an Edo-period Japan roleplay and progression game on Roblox. You earn Ryō, take on jobs, build reputation, and climb the social ladder from common laborer to Shogun.

items.question: Is Shogun's Reign free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Shogun's Reign is free to play on Roblox — you can earn Ryō, level up jobs, and climb the ranks without spending anything.

items.question: How do I earn Ryō fast in Shogun's Reign?
items.answer: Shogun's Reign rewards steady work: pick a job that matches your playtime, farm or trade consistently, and reinvest early Ryō into upgrades that raise your income.

items.question: How do Shogun's Reign ranks work?
items.answer: Shogun's Reign ranks run from common laborer to samurai, noble, and finally Shogun. Each tier unlocks new duties, cosmetics, and access, and progress carries across sessions.

items.question: Do Shogun's Reign codes expire?
items.answer: Yes. Shogun's Reign codes are promotional and expire quietly, so redeem any working code as soon as you find it — timed boosts especially.

items.question: Which job should beginners pick in Shogun's Reign?
items.answer: New players should start with Farmer or Attendant in Shogun's Reign for low-cost, reliable Ryō, then branch into Merchant or Artisan once they understand the economy.
